LanguageData.Gun_M21_RWP.label: M21
LanguageData.Gun_M21_RWP.description: The M21 is a high-caliber sniper rifle prized for its exceptional accuracy and stopping power. Originating from mid-20th-century military designs, it is ideal for long-range engagements, allowing a shooter to pick off enemies from a distance with precision. While it lacks the fire rate of more modern weapons, its ability to deliver decisive, one-shot damage makes it a favorite among skilled marksmen. Best used in open or elevated positions, its reliability shines in competent hands.
